18-collapsible-tree-search.visual_critic_note: Intentional Paul Tol palette, clean typographic hierarchy with rank-colored nodes and count badges, good whitespace — slightly undone by the large empty lower half of the viewport at default expansion depth.
18-collapsible-tree-search.encoding_integrity_note: No quantitative encoding violations (no bars, areas, or sized bubbles), categorical color is honest, SVG dimensions are data-driven via d3.extent, but node/link key functions use name+depth which is non-unique and fragile under permutation or duplicate-name data.
18-collapsible-tree-search.stress_test_note: No .interrupt() call before new transitions in update(), so rapid node clicks or expand-all during a 500ms animation will start conflicting transitions with stale x0/y0 anchor positions; all other interaction paths (search is debounced 200ms, pointer events unify mouse/touch, no brush/zoom so no update-storm or stale-scale risk) are sound.
18-collapsible-tree-search.cognitive_load_note: Progressive disclosure keeps the default view clean (2 levels, 12 visible nodes, 6 perceptually-distinct rank colors), and collapsed +N badges communicate hidden depth without overloading working memory; the main risk is navigational disorientation when fully expanded to ~200 nodes across 5 levels, though smooth 500ms transitions and search-with-auto-scroll mitigate this.
